definitions.explanation: An advanced state of human society characterized by developed culture, science, technology, and government.

⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧{文明|ぶんめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。

examples.english: To enjoy the benefits of modern civilization.
examples.notes: 文明の利器 = the conveniences/benefits of civilization

notes:
USAGE: {文明|ぶんめい} refers to large-scale human societies and their achievements. It often contrasts with nature or primitive states.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧{文明|ぶんめい} (ancient civilization)
・⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧{文明|ぶんめい} (modern civilization)
・⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧/⟦{東洋|とうよう}→東洋：03454_touyou⟧{文明|ぶんめい} (Western/Eastern civilization)
・{文明|ぶんめい}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (civilized society)
・{文明|ぶんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利器|りき}→利器：28188_riki⟧ (conveniences of civilization)

CONTRAST:
・⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ - culture (more specific to arts, customs)
・{文明|ぶんめい} - civilization (broader, technological/social development)
